learning_goals: Understand, analyse, compare, and implement gradient-based and curvature-based optimisation methods for engineering models.
Interpret convergence assumptions and distinguish local from global claims.
target_depth: Conceptual definitions, stated convergence results, algorithm semantics, and short implementation bridges.
proof_depth: Explain why assumptions support the result without reproducing full proofs.
assumptions_requiring_review: Learners know multivariable calculus, vectors, matrices, and basic Python but not formal convex optimisation.
Examples are unconstrained unless explicitly stated otherwise.
